input.free_text_description: This system is a distributed transactions platform that serves Candidate, User roles. It manages core business objects including roncoo user log. The platform provides capabilities for user. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include job/recommendation functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Candidate, I want to create and manage roncoo user log records, so that I can track and organize roncoo user log data effectively.
As a Candidate, I want to upload and manage files, so that I can store and retrieve documents when needed.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with api functionality, so that I can accomplish my api-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with index functionality, so that I can accomplish my index-related tasks.
